lagoon-island: Lagoon Island from the air: a tee on a rock headland, a turquoise lagoon with a tall rock stack standing in it, the island green beyond, boats and far islands under afternoon clouds.
canyon-run: Canyon Run at golden hour: a fairway running along the rim of a deep red gorge with a river at the bottom, mesas on the horizon.
lighthouse-point: Lighthouse Point: a green on top of grey sea cliffs with a striped lighthouse beside it, a blue cove full of sea stacks and boats, white headlands far off.
volcano-drop: Volcano Drop: island greens in a lake of crusted lava inside a crater, glowing lava falls on the walls and two tall rock fangs, under an ember sky.
frostbite-ridge: Frostbite Ridge: a fairway curling round a frozen lake in a bowl of snow and pines, with a wall of snow peaks behind.
sakura-garden: Sakura Garden: cherry trees in full blossom across a green valley, a cliff with waterfalls behind the green and misty mountains beyond.
temple-run: Temple Run: a jungle fairway crossing two rivers toward a stepped stone temple, thick forest all round and karst peaks in the mist.
pharaohs-gate: Pharaoh's Gate at sunset: pyramids and a carved temple wall behind a striped fairway and a blue pool, dunes rolling to the horizon.
midnight-mile: Midnight Mile at night: a fairway winding between towers of lit windows to a stadium green, searchlights and an airship overhead.
sky-fortress: Sky Fortress at golden hour: a causeway across a canyon lake to a butte with a castle green on top, red mesas all round.
dragons-spine: Dragon's Spine: a field of glowing lava below dark crater walls with lava falls, a dragon on a ledge, volcano cones smoking on the horizon.
summit-express: Summit Express: a ribbon of fairways climbing a snow mountain from a pine valley to a summit ringed by giant ice crystals.
bullseye-bay: Bullseye Bay: a round island green painted in target rings in a turquoise bay ringed by cliffs and waterfalls, boats at anchor.
thunder-dome: Thunder Dome from the tee: a floodlit stadium bowl with two tiers of spectators, big screens reading SUDDEN DEATH and a target green.
ice-pick: Ice Pick: a target painted in rings on a frozen tarn, snow slopes, pines and giant ice crystals all round, under a pink evening sky.
